series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); new items classified by the complete visible contrast; contrast-side targets (あまり, ようにしている, ので, わざと) labelled jlpt 3 because every one offers a well-formed N3 alternative; no N2 labels needed.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (lesson 1, page fetched 2026-11-17); Sensei and SKM not checked for this set
dispositions.note: Affirmative sense only ('quite, more than expected': なかなかおいしい, なかなかの出来, standalone なかなかですね). The negative 'not easily' sense (なかなか〜ない) is owned by negative-polarity-adverbs and appears here only in rationales and the article. あまり is a contrast-side target (2 items) so that the polarity contrast is practised.

groups.reason: なかなか (quite, more than expected), amount かなり and comparison ずっと, with あまり as the negative contrast.
Adverbs that predict their ending: guess, disbelief and question.
まるで likeness, then a vague feeling (ような気がする) against a deliberate habit (ようにしている).
Feeling as a reaction to a fact (ことに) against feeling as a reason (ので).
A valued chance (せっかく) against trouble taken (わざわざ).
Unintended (つい), proper (ちゃんと) and deliberate (わざと) actions.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

findings.location: small-shop-tasty, grandfather-runs, ずっと items, labels, article §1
findings.claim: なかなか was described as 'positive/favourable', but なかなか難しい is ordinary.
findings.change: Now 'quite; more than expected', with なかなか難しい noted; change-verb items argue from the verb pattern instead.

findings.claim: 'まるで needs a likeness ending' ignores まるで子どもだ and まるで + negative ('not at all').
findings.change: まるで is described as comparing with a resemblance, or with a negative meaning 'not at all'; cannot-lose has a specific まるで rationale; quiet-singer's ending was changed to とは、驚いた.

findings.claim: The article did not say that a な-adjective keeps な before ような気がする.
findings.change: Added 静かなような気がする and a 'な-adj + な' row.

findings.location: ような気がする and ようにしている items
findings.claim: 様 and ている／てる spellings were not all accepted.
歌手になるとは did not match the English 'became'.
findings.change: Now 歌手になったとは, also in the article example.

findings.claim: A duplicated gloss and stray spaces.

reviews.finalVerdict: CLEAN after reconciliation; temperature-forecast kept by the coordinator on facet A's linguistic judgement and listed as a known doubt

findings.claim: Degree-adverb option pairs were always keyed the same way, so the pool predicted the key.
findings.change: essay-praise now keys なかなか; new first-cake (key first-attempt); each pairing is keyed both ways.

findings.claim: つい vs わざと lacked a Japanese non-intention cue.
findings.change: Added つもりで…のに and 気がつくと cues; example key habit-shimau → time-slipped.

findings.claim: The distractor ちゃんと was valid (ちゃんと負けてあげた).
findings.change: ちゃんと removed; options are つい／わざと and the instruction names them.

findings.location: ような気がする ×3, ようにしている ×2
findings.claim: Typed variants (様, する／している／してる) were rejected.
findings.change: Accepted answers cover all variants; the instruction says so.

findings.claim: A shared かもしれない template predicted the key.
The なかなか distractor's exclusion rested on favourability; the replacement could not be certified from facet B.
findings.change: Replaced by temperature-forecast (key forecast-comparison); the rationale argues that なかなか + change verb takes the negative and does not widen a より comparison; listed in Known doubts.

findings.claim: ____おいしいね allowed ずっと with an implicit comparison.
A surprised まさか休みなのかな was possible, and the typed-mode instruction still listed まさか.
findings.change: まさか removed from closed-shop; trip-like-yesterday (key まるで) shares the reduced pool もしかしたら／一体／まるで; both instructions name exactly that pool; audit found 0 instruction/option mismatches in 49 items.

findings.claim: 一体 had no reading, and the 'Kana spellings' wording confused learners.
findings.change: Now 一体（いったい）; the wording was dropped.

findings.claim: The gloss for 眠れなく said 'can sleep'.
